case_brief.subject: Letter of Credit (LC) Mode of Payment
case_brief.administering_body: Railway Board / Indian Railway Electronic Procurement System (IREPS)
case_brief.what_it_is: A payment method for works or service tenders invited by railways through e-tendering on IREPS. It allows contractors to receive payments from Railways through a letter of credit arrangement.
case_brief.entitlement: The contractor receives payment for works or services passed by the Railway Accounts Office, released by the issuing bank (SBI) to the contractor's advising bank. The Railway (employer) issues a Document of Authorisation to enable the contractor to claim the authorized amount.
conditions: The tender must have an advertised value of Rs 10 lakh or above.
The contractor must exercise the option to take payment through LC at the time of bidding in IREPS.
The contractor must bear the incidental costs towards the issue and operation of the LC.
The contractor must select an advising/negotiating bank.

final.letter:
To,
Scheme grievance portal
Railway Board / Indian Railway Electronic Procurement System (IREPS)

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding flight cancellation and denial of monetary refund

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally register a grievance regarding the cancellation of my Delhi-Patna flight by IndiGo. Upon cancellation, the airline unilaterally issued a credit shell instead of providing a monetary refund. The total cost of the ticket was ₹6,800. Under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, forcing a consumer to accept a credit shell for a service that the airline failed to provide constitutes an unfair trade practice . As the service was not rendered, I am entitled to a full refund to my original payment method. I request that you process the refund of ₹6,800 immediately. Please resolve this matter within 7 days. If I do not receive a satisfactory response, I will be compelled to escalate this grievance to the National Consumer Helpline and the relevant Consumer Commission.

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

Scheme and case sources:
- https://ireps.gov.in/ireps/upload/files/67578357/ProcedureforLetterofCredit.pdf
